name: plastikkimik-pytangy
description: Ecossistema digital Plastikkimik Pytangy - economia circular e bioplástico de pétalas de rosas (Equipe FIH - INTEGRA SENAI 2026)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
